body:
Can you post the code where you use the function `isAuthorized` in your AdminController ?

Because i think you forgot to set `prefix => false` in the redirect link. I had a similar problem.
i don't have adminController because i'am using "admin" prefix and isAuthorized only in AppController, i didn't define any redirection link it works by default

Yeah sorry, i didn't read good, my bad. I had a similar case, but i used the beforeFilter not the `isAuthorized` action.
I just saw in the doc that : http://book.cakephp.org/3.0/en/controllers/components/authentication.html#configuration-options

```
unauthorizedRedirect
    Controls handling of unauthorized access. By default unauthorized user is redirected to the 
    referrer URL or loginAction or ‘/’. If set to false a ForbiddenException exception is thrown 
    instead of redirecting.
```

I know you can set up a custom `loginAction` URL, and **maybe** with the configuration `prefix => false` it will redirect to the good URL. 

``` php
'Auth' => [
    'authorize' => ['Controller'],
    'loginAction' => [
        'controller' => 'pages',
        'action' => 'home',
        'prefix' => false
    ],
]
```

Adapt the controller name and action name to your needs.

I have reproduced the bug, and yes you are right, by default it redirect me to `http://localhost/installFolder/installFolder` where `installFolder` is the root directory of the application.
Now, i have saw in the doc this configuration key : `unauthorizedRedirect` and tried this :

``` php
'Auth' => [
    'unauthorizedRedirect' => [
        'controller' => 'pages',
        'action' => 'home',
        'prefix' => false
    ]
]
```

and it worked perfectly. (Don't forget the `prefix => false`)

Thanks for the additional info @Xety I think this is related to the use of string URLs. CakePHP has had a few problems with string URLs getting the base path duplicated, as it isn't clear whether or not the base path should be added. I can dig a bit further into this, as I think 2.x has a similar issue.

issue.body:
When the referer is `/` Controller::referer() should not be appending the base path as it results in the base path being added twice causing incorrect results in AuthComponent.

Refs #4812
